repo_summary.name: retrieval-backend-with-rag
repo_summary.description: Vietnamese RAG backend and evaluation toolkit for product question answering, semantic routing, retrieval, reranking, LLM inference, benchmarks, and evaluation.
repo_summary.final_goal: Serve a chatbot backend that can route chat messages between product RAG and direct chitchat LLM response, using Vietnamese query rewriting and product data retrieval.

modules_layers.name: API and orchestration
modules_layers.responsibility: Receive chat messages, initialize dependencies, choose route, call retrieval/rerank/LLM, return assistant JSON.

modules_layers.name: Semantic routing
modules_layers.responsibility: Route rewritten Vietnamese query to products or chitchat by embedding similarity.

modules_layers.name: Reflection
modules_layers.responsibility: Rewrite contextual chat history into a standalone Vietnamese question.

modules_layers.name: RAG and retrieval
modules_layers.responsibility: Embed queries, search vector stores, ingest CSV into ChromaDB.

modules_layers.name: Reranking
modules_layers.responsibility: Score and sort retrieved passages using CrossEncoder.

modules_layers.name: Embeddings
modules_layers.responsibility: Provide local and API embedding wrappers.

modules_layers.name: LLM adapters
modules_layers.responsibility: Normalize generation across online and offline model backends.

modules_layers.name: Evaluation and benchmarks
modules_layers.responsibility: Measure retrieval, reranking, answer quality, and latency.

diagrams_source.architecture:
flowchart TB
  Client[Chatbot client] --> API[Flask serve.py POST /api/search]
  API --> Reflection[Reflection standalone Vietnamese query]
  Reflection --> Router[SemanticRouter products or chitchat]
  Router -->|products| RAG[RAG vector_search]
  RAG --> VectorDB[(ChromaDB MongoDB Qdrant)]
  RAG --> Reranker[CrossEncoder Reranker]
  Reranker --> Prompt[Sales prompt with ranked product context]
  Prompt --> LLM[LLMs facade]
  Router -->|chitchat| LLM
  LLM --> Response[assistant JSON response]

diagrams_source.runtime_data_flow:
sequenceDiagram
  participant C as Client
  participant S as serve.py
  participant RF as Reflection
  participant RT as SemanticRouter
  participant R as RAG
  participant V as Vector DB
  participant RR as Reranker
  participant L as LLM
  C->>S: POST /api/search messages[]
  S->>RF: chat history
  RF->>L: rewrite prompt
  L-->>RF: standalone query
  RF-->>S: query
  S->>RT: guide(query)
  alt products
    S->>R: vector_search(query)
    R->>V: query embedding
    V-->>R: candidate docs
    R-->>S: passages
    S->>RR: rerank(query, passages)
    RR-->>S: ranked passages
    S->>L: sales prompt with context
  else chitchat
    S->>L: original chat messages
  end
  L-->>S: generated text
  S-->>C: {content, role}
